map.阻生智齿 Pell-Gregory 分类器 使用指南: Impacted Wisdom Tooth Pell-Gregory Classifier — User Guide
map.根据下颌第三磨牙与升支前缘、咬合平面的关系分类，结合 Winter 分类角度评估: Classifies by the relation of the mandibular third molar to the ascending ramus anterior border and occlusal plane, combined with Winter's angle to assess extraction difficulty.
map.近中阻生智齿，输入与升支前缘/咬合平面关系，工具给出 Pell-Gregory: For mesially impacted wisdom teeth, enter the relation to ramus border/occlusal plane; the tool returns the Pell-Gregory class and difficulty.
map.水平阻生伴下颌神经管重叠，提示拔除风险高需 CBCT。: Horizontal impaction overlapping the mandibular canal signals high extraction risk—CBCT needed.
map.垂直阻生间隙充足，提示难度相对低但仍需评估冠周。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛: Vertical impaction with adequate space suggests relatively low difficulty but still needs pericoronal assessment. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis/treatment by dentists, orthodontists, or periodontists; if you have toothache, gingival bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa, or bite discomfort, promptly visit a qualified hospital's stomatology department.)
map.：输入：智齿牙冠完全位于升支前缘前方（I 类），咬合平面以上（A 位），近中倾斜:
: Input: crown fully anterior to ramus border (Class I), above occlusal plane (Position A), mesial tilt 45°
Verdict: I-A, relatively ample space, lower difficulty; reaching II/III or B/C raises difficulty.
map.按智齿与升支前缘关系分 I/II/III 类（空间递减），按与咬合平面关系分 A: By relation to ramus border: Classes I/II/III (decreasing space); by relation to occlusal plane: Positions A/B/C (descending position); combine to assess difficulty.
map.按阻生方向分垂直、近中、远中、水平、颊舌向等；水平/近中阻生常难度更高，需结合影: By impaction direction: vertical, mesial, distal, horizontal, buccolingual, etc.; horizontal/mesial often harder, needing imaging.
map.什么情况要拔智齿？: When should wisdom teeth be extracted?
map.反复冠周炎、龋坏、邻牙压迫吸收、囊肿或正畸需要；下颌神经管邻近者需 CBCT，由: Recurrent pericoronitis, caries, adjacent-tooth resorption, cysts, or orthodontic need; those near the mandibular canal need CBCT and maxillofacial evaluation.
